opening.argument: The broadcast presents a raid on call centers associated with pornographic sites, not an invitation to take part in their activity. Its news headline identifies the NBI raid, while the report attributes the sale of sites to the call-center operators and says investigators were examining whether a client's credit card was hacked. The request to subscribe to the news channel is ordinary audience engagement. Nothing in the described material establishes that clients were deceived, that payments were unauthorized, or that the creator solicited viewers to engage in the reported conduct.

citations.quote: The NBA has been raiding the two separate call centers in Quezon City which are also selling pornographic sites to clients from other countries.
The group is also to find out if the client credit card is hacked.
